title: Predicting Measles Vaccination Defaulting in Uganda and Kenya: Comparative Evaluation of Custom Soft Voting and TabNet Stacked Ensemble Architectures
abstract: Abstract Background Measles is a major cause of death among infants despite free routine immunization (RI) in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Vaccination defaulting contributes to measles outbreak occurrences. Conventional immunization defaulter identification methods are expensive to implement, prone to data falsification, reactive, and overestimate uptake. Several machine learning studies leveraged the use of child and maternal characteristics as predictors of immunization defaulting, overlooking community, demographic, and socioeconomic factors. Similarly, there is limited research regarding the use of interpretable deep learning and advanced ensemble methods to improve model performance in predicting RI defaulters and establishing significant predictors at the national level in the LMIC context, like Uganda. Objective This study predicts infants at a risk of defaulting on measles vaccination in Uganda and Kenya using advanced ensemble learning architectures. Methods The study benchmarked classical and deep learning models using Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) datasets (2016-2022) with child, maternal, community, social-economic, and demographic characteristics as predictors. The robust modeling pipeline began with feature selection according to the literature and the expert domain. It was followed by vaccination eligibility, missing value handling, and feature elimination using the phi-k correlation framework. To mitigate class imbalance, synthetic minority over-sampling technique for nominal continuous features was used in a training pipeline after the RobustScaler. Nine baseline classifiers, including Tabular Network (TabNet), multilayer perceptron (MLP), random forest (RF), gradient boosting (GB), adaptive-boosting (AB), among others, underwent stratified k-fold cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization via grid search. Custom soft voting was evaluated alongside TabNet stack architecture for superior ensemble prediction. Models were evaluated for accuracy, precision, recall, and F 1 -score. Model explainability was decoded using Shapley additive explanations (SHAP), while Streamlit and SQLite formed the tool architecture. Results The proposed TabNet+GB+RF custom soft voting achieved significant, nonrandom performance over tuned base models with an F 1 -score of 0.7111, area under the curve (AUC) of 0.8847 for Kenya. Conversely, for Uganda, the TabNet hybrid ensemble (GB+RF+ AB→TabNet) was the best with AUC of 0.8862 and F 1 -score of 0.6756, which was statistically insignificant. SHAP identified child’s age and vitamin A1 as universal key predictors in both countries; others varied. In Kenya, time to water source, respondents’ education, district lived previously, and current district were the most influential global features, respectively. In Uganda, Polio inactive, Pentavalent3, current district, and respondents’ education were the most influential factors to defaulting, respectively. Conclusions The proposed advanced ensemble learning models improved the classification of measles vaccine defaulters compared to individual models. The study recommends distinct country-tailored strategies. In Kenya, outreaches are recommended to areas with low literacy, distant water sources, and mobile populations. Conversely, in Uganda, the study recommends reminders to avoid missing preceding vaccines and outreaches to high-default districts.

title: Rapid Differentiation of Vaccine and Wild-Type Measles Virus During an Ongoing Outbreak using a new molecular assay
abstract: Abstract Background Differentiating wild and vaccine measles virus (MeV) strains is critical for appropriate healthcare response during outbreak vaccination campaigns. Sequencing, the current standard, is expensive, time-consuming, and limited to specialized laboratories. We developed and implemented a novel differential MeV RT-qPCR assay to address these challenges, which we describe herein. Methods We designed a differential two-step assay; the first step, termed MRRV, distinguishes between rubella, wild MeV, and vaccine MeV. The second, termed “MeV differential”, differentiates between genotypes A (vaccine), B and D. Results The assay detects 10-50 copies per reaction and accurately classifies weak clinical samples (Cq > 32), with 100% accuracy, compared with the N gene sequencing gold standard. Evaluated on over 4,000 clinical samples retrospectively and during the 2025-2026MeV outbreak in Israel, the assay revealed that ∼9% of tested originated from vaccine strain. Among tested municipalities, those running active vaccination campaigns had significantly higher vaccine strain detections (>10 cases each) than those with routine vaccination (1-2 cases). Retrospective analysis of samples from 2018-2024 identified a mix of B and D strains. The novel assay successfully identified double infection cases (exposure to a wild strain shortly before or after vaccination). Conclusion The novel assay proved useful both as a diagnostic tool that enables focused, efficient healthcare response, and as an epidemiological tool that provides valuable information in real-time. This assay is faster, cheaper and more amendable for high throughput testing, compared with the gold-standard sequencing classification.

title_zh: 使用新的分子测定在持续的 疫苗 和野生型 麻疹病毒 过程中快速分化 疫苗 和野生型 麻疹病毒
source_body_en: Abstract Background Differentiating wild and vaccine measles virus (MeV) strains is critical for appropriate healthcare response during outbreak vaccination campaigns. Sequencing, the current standard, is expensive, time-consuming, and limited to specialized laboratories. We developed and implemented a novel differential MeV RT-qPCR assay to address these challenges, which we describe herein. Methods We designed a differential two-step assay; the first step, termed MRRV, distinguishes between rubella, wild MeV, and vaccine MeV. The second, termed “MeV differential”, differentiates between genotypes A (vaccine), B and D. Results The assay detects 10-50 copies per reaction and accurately classifies weak clinical samples (Cq > 32), with 100% accuracy, compared with the N gene sequencing gold standard. Evaluated on over 4,000 clinical samples retrospectively and during the 2025-2026MeV outbreak in Israel, the assay revealed that ∼9% of tested originated from vaccine strain. Among tested municipalities, those running active vaccination campaigns had significantly higher vaccine strain detections (>10 cases each) than those with routine vaccination (1-2 cases). Retrospective analysis of samples from 2018-2024 identified a mix of B and D strains. The novel assay successfully identified double infection cases (exposure to a wild strain shortly before or after vaccination). Conclusion The novel assay proved useful both as a diagnostic tool that enables focused, efficient healthcare response, and as an epidemiological tool that provides valuable information in real-time. This assay is faster, cheaper and more amendable for high throughput testing, compared with the gold-standard sequencing classification.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 区分野生菌株和 疫苗 麻疹病毒 (MeV) 菌株对于 暴发 疫苗接种 活动期间适当的医疗保健响应至关重要。目前的标准测序昂贵、耗时,并且仅限于专业实验室。我们开发并实施了一种新颖的差异 MeV RT-qPCR 测定来应对这些挑战,我们在此进行了描述。方法我们设计了一种差异两步测定法;第一步称为 MRRV,区分风疹、野生 MeV 和 疫苗 MeV。第二个称为“MeV 差异”,区分基因型 A (疫苗)、B 和 D。结果 与 N 基因测序金标准相比,该检测每次反应可检测 10-50 个拷贝,并对弱临床样本 (Cq > 32) 进行准确分类,准确度为 100%。该检测对以色列 2025-2026MeV 暴发 期间的 4,000 多个临床样本进行回顾性评估,结果显示约 9% 的测试样本源自 疫苗 菌株。在接受测试的城市中,那些开展积极 疫苗接种 活动的城市的 疫苗 菌株检出率(每个 > 10 例)明显高于那些进行常规 疫苗接种 活动的城市(1-2 例)。对 2018-2024 年样本的回顾性分析发现了 B 型和 D 型菌株的混合。新的检测方法成功地识别出双重感染病例(在 疫苗接种 之前或之后不久接触野生菌株)。结论 事实证明,这种新颖的检测方法既可以作为一种诊断工具,能够实现集中、高效的医疗保健响应,又可以作为一种流行病学工具,实时提供有价值的信息。与金标准测序分类相比,这种测定更快、更便宜且更适合高通量测试。

title: Measles Vaccine Uptake During the 2025 Texas Measles Outbreak in a San Antonio Military Medical Center
abstract: Abstract Objective To evaluate changes in measles-containing vaccine (MCV) uptake, inclusive of MMR and MMRV, by age group and over time during the 2025 Texas measles outbreak. Methods We conducted a retrospective, single-center, observational study comparing January through August 2024 (pre-outbreak) with the same period in 2025 (outbreak) at a military medical center in San Antonio, TX. The study evaluated MCVs administered and recorded in the electronic health record (EHR) to all patients from 0-18 years enrolled during these periods. The primary outcome was the MCV administration rate (doses per 1,000 child-months). Based on this, we estimated incidence rate ratios (IRR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing 2025 vs 2024 overall and by age groups. Results MCV administration increased from 10.82 per 1,000 child-months in 2024 to 13.22 per 1,000 child-months in 2025, across all age groups (IRR 1.22; 95% CI, 1.11–1.34; p<0.001). This increase was driven by early-dose vaccination in infants aged 6-11 months (IRR 21.09; 95% CI, 9.89–44.98) and children aged 24-47 months (IRR 4.73; 95% CI, 2.84–7.87). MCV administration rates did not clearly differ among children 12-23 months (IRR 1.08; 95% CI, 0.94–1.24), 4-5 years (IRR 1.07; 95% CI, 0.93–1.23), or 6-18 years (IRR 0.54; 95% CI, 0.28–1.06). Peak vaccine uptake occurred early in the outbreak and then declined toward baseline. Conclusions At a military medical center in San Antonio, the 2025 Texas measles outbreak was associated with an early transient increase in MCV uptake principally driven by early infant vaccination, and by late summer, the uptake returned toward baseline.
journal: Journal of the Pediatric Infectious Diseases Society

title_zh: 麻疹 疫苗 2025 年德克萨斯州 麻疹 暴发 在圣安东尼奥军事医疗中心的吸收
source_body_en: Abstract Objective To evaluate changes in measles-containing vaccine (MCV) uptake, inclusive of MMR and MMRV, by age group and over time during the 2025 Texas measles outbreak. Methods We conducted a retrospective, single-center, observational study comparing January through August 2024 (pre-outbreak) with the same period in 2025 (outbreak) at a military medical center in San Antonio, TX. The study evaluated MCVs administered and recorded in the electronic health record (EHR) to all patients from 0-18 years enrolled during these periods. The primary outcome was the MCV administration rate (doses per 1,000 child-months). Based on this, we estimated incidence rate ratios (IRR) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) comparing 2025 vs 2024 overall and by age groups. Results MCV administration increased from 10.82 per 1,000 child-months in 2024 to 13.22 per 1,000 child-months in 2025, across all age groups (IRR 1.22; 95% CI, 1.11–1.34; p<0.001). This increase was driven by early-dose vaccination in infants aged 6-11 months (IRR 21.09; 95% CI, 9.89–44.98) and children aged 24-47 months (IRR 4.73; 95% CI, 2.84–7.87). MCV administration rates did not clearly differ among children 12-23 months (IRR 1.08; 95% CI, 0.94–1.24), 4-5 years (IRR 1.07; 95% CI, 0.93–1.23), or 6-18 years (IRR 0.54; 95% CI, 0.28–1.06). Peak vaccine uptake occurred early in the outbreak and then declined toward baseline. Conclusions At a military medical center in San Antonio, the 2025 Texas measles outbreak was associated with an early transient increase in MCV uptake principally driven by early infant vaccination, and by late summer, the uptake returned toward baseline.

title: Generating Insights Into (Mis)Information About Measles Vaccination in Amsterdam Through Social Listening, the Netherlands, 2024
abstract: Background: HPV-vaccination prevents HPV-related cancers, but uptake remains suboptimal. In the Netherlands, a catch-up campaign invited 18-27-year-olds for an additional cost-free opportunity to initiate or complete their HPV-vaccination in 2023-2024, which led to 24% of this invited population getting vaccinated. As young adults increasingly seek health information online, understanding online questions, concerns and misinformation in response to the campaign may help improve future vaccination efforts. Supplemental to overall evaluation of the vaccination campaign, we piloted online social listening processes to generate an insight report for Public Health Service (PHS) Amsterdam. Objective This study piloted online social listening processes at the PHS Amsterdam to identify actionable insights into questions, concerns and misinformation surrounding the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign among young adults. Methods Upon inventory of potential platforms and data sources, a retrospective online social listening analysis was conducted across the platforms Instagram, Facebook, and X, collecting data from PHS, the National Public Health Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), the Dutch public broadcasting foundation (NOS), and LINDA.meiden sources from January 1, 2023, to June 1, 2024. Publicly available posts, comments, and engagement concerning HPV-vaccination were manually collected, and inductively coded. Themes were assessed for risk, based on expected potential harm and observed reach, and used to develop recommendations. Results A total of 821 posts and 5157 comments were collected and analysed. Ten recurring themes were identified across varying levels of risk. Two themes were classified as high risk: an information gap regarding the effectiveness of HPV-vaccination and concerns about the transparency on HPV-vaccine side effects. Three themes were classified as medium risk: questioning HPV-vaccine effectiveness under certain circumstances, reduced general vaccine trust following COVID-19, and accessibility issues related to vaccination locations and service times. Two themes were classified as neutral risk: questions regarding eligibility criteria for the campaign and calls for broader HIPV-prevention measures. Finally, three low risk themes concerned questions regarding HPV-vaccine brand specifics, campaign choices, and questions about scheduling or rescheduling HPV-appointments. Comments also referred to subsequent information sources, including reliable sources (public health institutes), false narratives and misinformation. Recommendations focused on addressing questions and information gaps (i.e. improving HPV risk perception and providing more detailed HPV-vaccine information), improving communication about HPV-vaccination, and reducing practical barriers to vaccination. Conclusions Manual social listening across selected online sources provided actionable insights into the public discourse during the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign. Results mostly reflected questions, concerns and information gaps. Although some themes were critical of HPV-vaccination, false narratives and misinformation did not dominate the discourse. Recommendations aim to reduce practical barriers and address information needs. This pilot showed that online social listening can be effectively implemented even with limited resources.

As young adults increasingly seek health information online, understanding online questions, concerns and misinformation in response to the campaign may help improve future vaccination efforts. Supplemental to overall evaluation of the vaccination campaign, we piloted online social listening processes to generate an insight report for Public Health Service (PHS) Amsterdam. Objective This study piloted online social listening processes at the PHS Amsterdam to identify actionable insights into questions, concerns and misinformation surrounding the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign among young adults. Methods Upon inventory of potential platforms and data sources, a retrospective online social listening analysis was conducted across the platforms Instagram, Facebook, and X, collecting data from PHS, the National Public Health Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM), the Dutch public broadcasting foundation (NOS), and LINDA.meiden sources from January 1, 2023, to June 1, 2024. Publicly available posts, comments, and engagement concerning HPV-vaccination were manually collected, and inductively coded. Themes were assessed for risk, based on expected potential harm and observed reach, and used to develop recommendations. Results A total of 821 posts and 5157 comments were collected and analysed. Ten recurring themes were identified across varying levels of risk. Two themes were classified as high risk: an information gap regarding the effectiveness of HPV-vaccination and concerns about the transparency on HPV-vaccine side effects. Three themes were classified as medium risk: questioning HPV-vaccine effectiveness under certain circumstances, reduced general vaccine trust following COVID-19, and accessibility issues related to vaccination locations and service times. Two themes were classified as neutral risk: questions regarding eligibility criteria for the campaign and calls for broader HIPV-prevention measures. Finally, three low risk themes concerned questions regarding HPV-vaccine brand specifics, campaign choices, and questions about scheduling or rescheduling HPV-appointments. Comments also referred to subsequent information sources, including reliable sources (public health institutes), false narratives and misinformation. Recommendations focused on addressing questions and information gaps (i.e. improving HPV risk perception and providing more detailed HPV-vaccine information), improving communication about HPV-vaccination, and reducing practical barriers to vaccination. Conclusions Manual social listening across selected online sources provided actionable insights into the public discourse during the HPV-vaccination catch-up campaign. Results mostly reflected questions, concerns and information gaps. Although some themes were critical of HPV-vaccination, false narratives and misinformation did not dominate the discourse. Recommendations aim to reduce practical barriers and address information needs. This pilot showed that online social listening can be effectively implemented even with limited resources.

abstract_zh: 背景:HPV-疫苗接种 可预防 HPV 相关癌症,但摄取量仍不理想。在荷兰,一项追赶活动邀请 18-27 岁的人在 2023 年至 2024 年期间获得额外的免费机会来启动或完成 HPV-疫苗接种,这导致受邀人群中有 24% 接种了疫苗。随着年轻人越来越多地在网上寻求健康信息,了解针对该活动的在线问题、担忧和错误信息可能有助于改善未来的 疫苗接种 工作。作为对 疫苗接种 活动总体评估的补充,我们试点了在线社交聆听流程,为阿姆斯特丹公共卫生服务 (PHS) 生成洞察报告。目的 本研究在阿姆斯特丹 PHS 试行了在线社交聆听流程,以找出针对年轻人中有关 HPV-疫苗接种 追赶活动的问题、担忧和错误信息的可行见解。方法 在清点潜在平台和数据源后,在 Instagram、Facebook 和 X 平台上进行回顾性在线社交聆听分析,收集 2023 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 6 月 1 日期间来自 PHS、国家公共卫生与环境研究所 (RIVM)、荷兰公共广播基金会 (NOS) 和 LINDA.meiden 来源的数据。收集起来,并进行感应编码。根据预期的潜在危害和观察到的影响范围对主题进行风险评估,并用于制定建议。结果 共收集并分析了 821 个帖子和 5157 条评论。在不同的风险级别中确定了十个反复出现的主题。两个主题被列为高风险:有关 HPV-疫苗接种 有效性的信息差距以及对 HPV-疫苗 副作用透明度的担忧。三个主题被归类为中等风险:质疑 HPV-疫苗 在某些情况下的有效性、COVID-19 后总体 疫苗 信任度降低,以及与 疫苗接种 位置和服务时间相关的可访问性问题。两个主题被列为中性风险:有关该活动资格标准的问题以及呼吁采取更广泛的 HIPV 预防措施。最后,三个低风险主题涉及有关 HPV-疫苗 品牌细节、活动选择的问题,以及有关安排或重新安排 HPV 预约的问题。评论还提到了后续的信息来源,包括可靠来源(公共卫生机构)、虚假叙述和错误信息。建议侧重于解决问题和信息差距(即提高 HPV 风险认知并提供更详细的 HPV-疫苗 信息)、改善有关 HPV-疫苗接种 的沟通以及减少 疫苗接种 的实际障碍。结论 通过选定的在线资源进行手动社交倾听,为 HPV-疫苗接种 追赶活动期间的公众话语提供了可行的见解。结果主要反映了问题、担忧和信息差距。尽管一些主题对 HPV-疫苗接种 持批评态度,但虚假叙述和错误信息并未主导讨论。建议旨在减少实际障碍并满足信息需求。该试点表明,即使资源有限,在线社交聆听也可以有效实施。

title: Hemagglutinin and fusion proteins precede measles virus ribonucleoproteins and marshal cell-to-cell spread in airway epithelium
abstract: ABSTRACT Measles virus (MeV) is the most contagious human respiratory pathogen. To understand how it spreads in the airways, we infected well-differentiated primary cultures of human airway epithelial cells (HAE). We discovered that the MeV attachment protein (hemagglutinin, H), the fusion (F) protein, and the assembly organizer protein (matrix, M) reach newly infected cells ahead of, and independently from, the replicative complex proteins. To characterize the mechanisms of MeV spread, we generated a replication-deficient adenoviral vector expressing the MeV M, F, and H proteins in a doxycycline-inducible manner. This viral vector formed infectious centers that preserved epithelial function like those from MeV infection. To further dissect this process, we generated Ad vectors expressing individual MeV proteins, termed Ad-M, Ad-F, and Ad-H. Transduction of HAE with single, double, and triple Ad vector combinations revealed that Ad-F and Ad-H are necessary and sufficient to form MeV-like infectious centers. MeV enters and spreads within airway epithelia via H protein binding to adherens junction protein, nectin-4. To disrupt spread, we introduced the point mutation HY543A, a mutation previously described to inhibit nectin-4 binding, in the Ad-H vector. Co-transduction of Ad-F and Ad-HY543A did not result in MeV-like infectious center formation. Finally, we assessed whether the MeV-related paramyxovirus Nipah (NiV) attachment and fusion proteins (G and F, respectively) support cell-to-cell spread. Co-transduction of HAE with Ad-NiV-G and Ad-NiV-F did not result in infectious center formation, suggesting that decoupling of the membrane fusion apparatus function from replication is a unique feature of the MeV envelope glycoproteins. IMPORTANCE Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen. We characterized a mechanism by which measles virus spreads rapidly through the cells that line the human airway in an ex vivo model. We show that the proteins of the viral membrane fusion apparatus, hemagglutinin (H) and fusion (F), move independently from and reach newly infected cells before the proteins of the replicative complex. Thus, viral protein spread is assembled and arranged in order (i.e., marshaled). Using adenovirus-based vectors, we show that co-expression of H and F proteins promotes rapid sequential spread to multiple cells and the formation of infectious centers. Further elucidation of the mechanism of measles virus amplification and cell-to-cell spread within the lung may help explain its highly contagious nature. Measles virus is a highly contagious pathogen.

title: An evaluation of the performance and usability of a measles IgM rapid diagnostic test within the Uganda national surveillance program using capillary blood and oral fluid samples.
abstract: Abstract Performance of a prototype measles IgM rapid diagnostic test (RDT) was evaluated during suspected measles outbreaks in Uganda. Oral fluid (OF), capillary blood (CAP) and serum samples were collected from participants. OF and CAP were tested using the RDT at patient contact, while usability was assessed through questionnaires administered to health workers, patients, and guardians. Residual OF and IgM-positive RDTs from OF testing underwent measles qRT-PCR at Uganda Virus Research Institute. RDT performance was compared with Siemens anti-measles IgM ELISA performed on sera and with true measles cases, defined as measles ELISA IgM-positive and/or OF RT-PCR positive. Compared to ELISA, RDT sensitivity and specificity were 97.9% (95% CI: 93.7%–99.3%) and 91.7% (95% CI: 84.7%–95.7%) for CAP, and 96.7% (95% CI: 92.2%–98.6%) and 88.0% (95% CI: 80.7%–92.8%) for OF, respectively. Compared with true measles cases, sensitivity and specificity were 90.4% (95% CI: 84.9%–94.1%) and 89.2% (95% CI: 81.5%–94.0%) for CAP, and 88.5% (95% CI: 82.8%–92.5%) and 86.1% (95% CI: 78.1%–91.5%) for OF, respectively. OF and CAP sampling, and RDT use were highly acceptable, and health workers reported the RDT could improve measles management. The RDT demonstrated good accuracy and usability for outbreak settings.

title: Distinct Humoral Response Development to Measles Virus Across Vaccine Platforms.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Different measles vaccine platforms protect against clinical disease, but characteristics of the resulting humoral responses remain incompletely defined. METHODS: In this study, a phage display immunoprecipitation sequencing technology, VirScan, was employed to evaluate measles viral epitope coverage by antibodies following wild-type (WT) measles virus (MeV) infection of rhesus macaques, or vaccination with a live attenuated MeV vaccine (LAMV), the triple measles-mumps-rubella vaccine (MMR), or a novel recombinant MeV hemagglutinin protein-based vaccine (rMeVH). Vaccinated animals were also challenged with WT MeV to measure antibody epitope reactivity during a recall. RESULTS: The results demonstrate that WT MeV infection elicited a broader epitope reactivity profile than LAMV-containing vaccines. Also, rMeVH vaccination not only resulted in a narrow H protein-specific antibody profile, but epitopes recognized were distinct from LAMV-vaccinated or WT-challenged animals. All vaccine groups expanded the breadth of MeV-specific antibody repertoires following WT MeV challenge. In addition, MeV-specific VarScore, a measure of overall antigen binding, was positively correlated with IgG titer assessed by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, as well as antibody avidity and neutralizing titers. CONCLUSIONS: The results demonstrate the distinct effects of vaccination platforms on the breadth and fine specificity of anti-measles-induced humoral responses, and the utility of VirScan for comprehensively assessing antibody epitope targets.

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.

abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

title: Case Study on Formulating a Multidose Lyophilized Measles-Rubella (MR) Vaccine Candidate for Local Manufacturing in Africa: Lab-Scale Results and Lessons Learned for Future Technology Transfer
abstract: Background/Objectives: Local manufacturing of Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccines is part of a multifaceted approach to improve vaccine accessibility in Africa, yet process development and technology transfer challenges remain for large-scale production of viral bulks and lyophilized drug product. This case study describes lab-scale formulation development of a multidose, lyophilized MR vaccine candidate, leveraging the availability of concentrated bulks of Measles (MeV) and Rubella (RuV) produced in MRC-5 cells by a new bulk manufacturing process. Methods: Formulation studies utilized both high-throughput RT-qPCR viral infectivity assays and standard lyophilization measurements. The off-patent, publicly available formulation composition of a single-dose, lyophilized trivalent MMR vaccine was evaluated as a starting point to develop a multidose, bivalent lyophilized MR vaccine candidate. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹-风疹 (MR) 疫苗 的本地生产是提高 疫苗 在非洲可及性的多方面方法的一部分,但大规模生产病毒原料和冻干药品仍然面临工艺开发和技术转让挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本案例研究描述了多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的实验室规模制剂开发,利用了通过新的散装制造工艺在 MRC-5 细胞中生产的 麻疹 (MeV) 和风疹 (RuV) 浓缩散装的可用性。
elements_zh.methods: 制剂研究利用高通量 RT-qPCR 病毒感染性测定和标准冻干测量。对单剂量冻干三价 MMR 疫苗 的非专利公开制剂组合物进行评估,作为开发多剂量二价冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的起点。为了确定最佳条件,对各种配方(例如人血清白蛋白、病毒体积)、药品(例如小瓶尺寸、填充体积)和冻干(例如冷冻速率、初级/二级干燥周期)参数进行了评估,以降低成本并评估冻干、储存和重构期间的 MR 稳定性。
elements_zh.main_results: 对顶级候选 MR 配方的四种变体进行了实时和加速稳定性研究,将其填充到为技术转让而选择的初级包装中,并在实验室和中试规模的冷冻干燥机中冻干。优化的五剂量 MR 疫苗 配方含有 5% (v/v) 散装和 95% (v/v) 稳定剂溶液,以 2X 填充并重构至 1X 浓度,表现出良好的稳定性和降低成本的潜力。2-8°C 的稳定性曲线用于估计确保保质期结束时所需的失效剂量所需的 MR 释放剂量。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 讨论了结果以及对未来工作的建议,讨论了在实验室规模开发候选多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 剂型过程中遇到的分析、配方和冻干挑战,该剂型旨在用于非洲的技术转让和大规模本地生产。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为多剂量冻干 MR 疫苗 候选药物的配方和稳定性提供了见解,这可以为未来的技术转让工作提供信息,并支持非洲本地制造,以提高 疫苗 的可及性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于实验室规模的结果,不包括大规模生产数据,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。由于侧重于实验室规模的开发且缺乏临床试验数据,证据强度中等。

title: A Multipatch Model for Evaluating Interdivisional Connectivity and Vaccination Dynamics in the 2026 Bangladesh Measles Outbreak
abstract: The 2026 measles resurgence in Bangladesh motivates a spatial modelling framework that accounts for heterogeneous local transmission, vaccination activity, and interdivisional connectivity. We formulate a multipatch susceptible-vaccinated-infectious-recovered model for the eight administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Division-specific parameters are estimated from reported measles cases \cite{DGHS} and smoothed vaccination data using bounded nonlinear least squares, with uncertainty quantified through 1000 parametric bootstrap replicates. The fitted divisional systems are then connected through compartment-specific movement and cross-patch infection coefficients adjusted for connectivity and the source division's relative reproduction number. The fitted model captures the main division-specific epidemic patterns. Estimated local reproduction numbers range from \(1.1386\) in Khulna (95\% CI:\(0.5703\)--\(1.3834\)) to \(4.3491\) in Dhaka (95\% CI: \(1.4449\)--\(5.6307\)), while Chattogram also exhibits high transmission potential (\(\mathcal{R}_0^i=4.2275\); 95\% CI: \(4.0019\)--\(4.3185\)). Baseline spatial coupling increases the network-wide epidemic peak from \(190.96\) to \(313.20\) infectious individuals and more than doubles cumulative infections from \(1086.42\) to \(2345.35\). Relative to baseline coupling, 50\% and 80\% restrictions reduce the epidemic peak by \(26.69\%\) and \(34.37\%\), and cumulative infections by \(25.07\%\) and \(41.48\%\), respectively. Conversely, a 50\% increase in spatial coupling raises the peak by \(30.14\%\) and cumulative infections by \(23.54\%\). Although local transmission remains dominant in every division, cross-patch infection accounts for \(28.83\%\) of new infections in Rajshahi at the baseline epidemic peak. Source-sink analysis identifies Dhaka as the dominant cross-patch source and Chattogram as a smaller secondary source.

title_zh: 用于评估 2026 年孟加拉国部门间连通性和 疫苗接种 动态的多面体模型 麻疹 暴发
source_body_en: The 2026 measles resurgence in Bangladesh motivates a spatial modelling framework that accounts for heterogeneous local transmission, vaccination activity, and interdivisional connectivity. We formulate a multipatch susceptible-vaccinated-infectious-recovered model for the eight administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Division-specific parameters are estimated from reported measles cases \cite{DGHS} and smoothed vaccination data using bounded nonlinear least squares, with uncertainty quantified through 1000 parametric bootstrap replicates. The fitted divisional systems are then connected through compartment-specific movement and cross-patch infection coefficients adjusted for connectivity and the source division's relative reproduction number. The fitted model captures the main division-specific epidemic patterns. Estimated local reproduction numbers range from \(1.1386\) in Khulna (95\% CI:\(0.5703\)--\(1.3834\)) to \(4.3491\) in Dhaka (95\% CI: \(1.4449\)--\(5.6307\)), while Chattogram also exhibits high transmission potential (\(\mathcal{R}_0^i=4.2275\); 95\% CI: \(4.0019\)--\(4.3185\)). Baseline spatial coupling increases the network-wide epidemic peak from \(190.96\) to \(313.20\) infectious individuals and more than doubles cumulative infections from \(1086.42\) to \(2345.35\). Relative to baseline coupling, 50\% and 80\% restrictions reduce the epidemic peak by \(26.69\%\) and \(34.37\%\), and cumulative infections by \(25.07\%\) and \(41.48\%\), respectively. Conversely, a 50\% increase in spatial coupling raises the peak by \(30.14\%\) and cumulative infections by \(23.54\%\). Although local transmission remains dominant in every division, cross-patch infection accounts for \(28.83\%\) of new infections in Rajshahi at the baseline epidemic peak. Source-sink analysis identifies Dhaka as the dominant cross-patch source and Chattogram as a smaller secondary source.

title: Complications Among Hospitalized Pediatric Patients with Measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, Indonesia, November 2025
abstract: Background: Measles is an infectious disease that remains a major concern in Indonesia. By mid-2025, more than 46 cases of measles outbreak had been reported in the country. Locally, at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, the number of hospitalized pediatric patients with measles rose from 11 in October 2025 to 28 in November 2025. Outbreak reports globally reported complications of measles including pneumonia and dehydration. These complications can lead to hospitalization. This study aimed to identify the most prevalent complications among pediatric patients with measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, in November 2025 Method: This was a retrospective cross-sectional study on all pediatric patients aged <18 years old with a clinical diagnosis of measles hospitalized at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam, in November 2025. Total sampling was used in this study. Descriptive statistics was performed by Microsoft Excel 2016. Results: A total of 28 pediatric patients with measles were hospitalized. The mean age was 4 years and 9 months. The most prevalent age group was children aged 1 to <7 years old (64.3%). Fever and rash were present in all patients (100.0%), followed by cough (96.4%), and reduced oral intake (60.7%). Laboratory abnormalities observed include leukopenia (42.9%), thrombocytopenia (3.6%) and hyponatremia (21.4%). Fifteen patients (53.6%) had bronchopneumonia and 13 (46.4%) patients had dehydration. Conclusion: Bronchopneumonia and dehydration were the two most prevalent complications among pediatric patients hospitalized with measles at Rumah Sakit Hj. Bunda Halimah, Batam.
journal: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research

abstract_zh: 背景:麻疹 是一种传染病,在印度尼西亚仍然是一个主要问题。截至 2025 年中期,该国已报告超过 46 例 麻疹 暴发 病例。当地的 Rumah Sakit Hj。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,住院的 麻疹 儿科患者人数从 2025 年 10 月的 11 例增加到 2025 年 11 月的 28 例。麻疹 报告了全球报告的 麻疹 并发症,包括肺炎和脱水。这些并发症可能导致住院。本研究旨在确定 Rumah Sakit Hj 的 麻疹 儿科患者中最常见的并发症。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,2025 年 11 月 方法:这是一项针对在 Rumah Sakit Hj 住院的所有年龄 <18 岁、临床 麻疹 为 麻疹 的儿科患者的回顾性横断面研究。巴淡岛 Bunda Halimah,2025 年 11 月。本研究使用了总抽样。采用Microsoft Excel 2016进行描述性统计。结果:共有28例麻疹患儿住院。平均年龄为 4 岁零 9 个月。最常见的年龄组是 1 岁至 <7 岁的儿童(64.3%)。所有患者均出现发热和皮疹(100.0%),其次是咳嗽(96.4%)和进食减少(60.7%)。观察到的实验室异常包括白细胞减少症(42.9%)、血小板减少症(3.6%)和低钠血症(21.4%)。15 名患者(53.6%)患有支气管肺炎,13 名患者(46.4%)患有脱水。结论:支气管肺炎和脱水是 Rumah Sakit Hj 住院的 麻疹 儿童患者中最常见的两种并发症。巴淡岛本达哈莉玛。

title: Measles in children: clinical and epidemiological portrait of the infection in modern conditions
abstract: Objective: To study the clinical and epidemiological characteristics of measles in children during a massive increase in incidence. Materials and Methods: A retrospective analysis of 189 medical records of children aged 0 to 17 years hospitalized in the infectious diseases hospital of Krasnoyarsk City Children's Clinical Hospital No. 1 in 2024 with a clinical diagnosis of measles was conducted. Among the patients observed, the most vulnerable group were children aged 1 year (26,5%), followed by schoolchildren aged 7 to 14 (25,9%), 99% of whom were unvaccinated against measles. To date, measles in childhood has retained its classic features; however, the pathognomonic symptom of Belsky-Filatov-Koplik spots was observed in only 67,5% of cases, and photophobia was observed in 14,3%. The overwhelming majority (84,6%) reported a moderate form of the disease, with a complex course, and complications, observed in 66,7% of cases, with a predominance among patients with a complicated premorbid background. The epidemiological situation for measles in Krasnoyarsk Krai in 2024 is characterized as unfavorable. Children under one year of age, unvaccinated due to underage vaccination, and schoolchildren aged 7 to 14 are most often affected, reflecting the accumulation of unvaccinated children in the population and insufficient herd immunity. Therefore, measles vaccination is a necessary, justified, and priority measure for the prevention of this disease.

title: Changing Measles Epidemiology in Ghana, 2018–2023: Exploring Impact of COVID-19-Related Disruptions on Vaccination Coverage and Incidence
abstract: Background: Measles remains a public health threat in Ghana due to persistent immunity gaps and suboptimal vaccination coverage. The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted routine immunization and may have altered measles transmission. This study assessed measles burden, vaccination status of confirmed cases, and spatiotemporal trends in Ghana, and examined the pandemic’s impact on measles control. Methods: We analyzed measles cases reported in Ghana from 2018 to 2023, including age, sex, vaccination status, and region, alongside national measles–rubella (MR) vaccination coverage. Cumulative incidence was calculated as confirmed cases per million population. Interrupted time series analysis assessed pandemic-related disruptions in vaccination coverage and case reporting. Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with infection and vaccination status. Results: Ghana reported 1688 confirmed measles cases, a cumulative incidence of 51.9 per million, with a case fatality rate of 0.1%. Incidence rose from 1.1 per 1,000,000 in 2018 to 28.3 per 1,000,000 in 2023, with wide geographic variation. title: COMPARATIVE RATE OF MEASLES AMONG VACCINATED AND UNVACCINATED SYMPTOMATIC CHILDREN: A CLINIC-BASED CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
abstract: Background Pakistan has been experiencing cases of measles even though there is a very effective and safe vaccine for this disease available for quite some time. The main reason for this is that Pakistan has very low vaccination rates. Objective To compare the rate of confirmed measles infection among vaccinated versus unvaccinated symptomatic children presenting to a pediatric unit, and to assess the magnitude of vaccine-associated protection using relative risk and odds ratio. Methods A clinic-based cross-sectional study was conducted for three months in pediatric departments of Saidu Group of Teaching hospitals,Swat and Northwest General Hospital, Peshawar.. The total number of participants involved in this study were four hundred, aged between 4 months[WA1] [rs2] and 15 years. Participants were categorized into two groups: those who were vaccinated (at least once) or those who were not vaccinated. Information regarding demographics, vaccination status, and measles status of patients was recorded via a questionnaire. Data analysis was performed in SPSS version 25. Results Out of the total 400 children involved in this study, 223 (55.8%) were boys[WA3] [rs4] , while 177 (44.3%) were girls, with a mean age of 4.7 years (± SD 3.8). Out of the total number of 400 children, 201 (50.2%) were diagnosed with the infection of measles. Vaccine coverage was found at 55.5% (n = 222). Maximum prevalence of the disease was seen among 5-10 year-old children (56.6%), Among confirmed measles cases, 58.7% were female and 41.3% were male (p=0.006); sex-specific attack rates were 66.7% in girls (118/177) vs. 37.2% in boys (83/223). There was a significant relationship between measles and vaccination status (p = 0.04), with vaccinated children having a 36% lower risk of measles (RR = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.54–0.75; OR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.24–0.57). Conclusion It was found that there were a lot of cases of measles in individuals who did not receive vaccination. It can be clearly seen from this study how important it is for the prevention of diseases to get vaccinated.

title_zh: 疫苗接种与未接种症状儿童中麻疹感染率的比较:基于临床的横断面研究
source_body_en: Background Pakistan has been experiencing cases of measles even though there is a very effective and safe vaccine for this disease available for quite some time. The main reason for this is that Pakistan has very low vaccination rates. Objective To compare the rate of confirmed measles infection among vaccinated versus unvaccinated symptomatic children presenting to a pediatric unit, and to assess the magnitude of vaccine-associated protection using relative risk and odds ratio. Methods A clinic-based cross-sectional study was conducted for three months in pediatric departments of Saidu Group of Teaching hospitals,Swat and Northwest General Hospital, Peshawar.. The total number of participants involved in this study were four hundred, aged between 4 months[WA1] [rs2] and 15 years. Participants were categorized into two groups: those who were vaccinated (at least once) or those who were not vaccinated. Information regarding demographics, vaccination status, and measles status of patients was recorded via a questionnaire. Data analysis was performed in SPSS version 25. Results Out of the total 400 children involved in this study, 223 (55.8%) were boys[WA3] [rs4] , while 177 (44.3%) were girls, with a mean age of 4.7 years (± SD 3.8). Out of the total number of 400 children, 201 (50.2%) were diagnosed with the infection of measles. Vaccine coverage was found at 55.5% (n = 222). Maximum prevalence of the disease was seen among 5-10 year-old children (56.6%), Among confirmed measles cases, 58.7% were female and 41.3% were male (p=0.006); sex-specific attack rates were 66.7% in girls (118/177) vs. 37.2% in boys (83/223). There was a significant relationship between measles and vaccination status (p = 0.04), with vaccinated children having a 36% lower risk of measles (RR = 0.64, 95% CI: 0.54–0.75; OR = 0.37, 95% CI: 0.24–0.57). Conclusion It was found that there were a lot of cases of measles in individuals who did not receive vaccination. It can be clearly seen from this study how important it is for the prevention of diseases to get vaccinated.

title: Epidemiologic shifts predict spatial patterns of measles re-emergence in the United States
abstract: Globally, measles is re-emerging in countries that have previously achieved elimination, including the United States. As immunization rates decline, characterizing the dynamics and evolving spatial pattern of measles re-emergence is critical to inform the public health response. We analyze annual county-level measles cases and vaccine coverage data in the United States (US) from 2011-2025 and find a shift in measles epidemiology in recent years indicative of re-emergence. While outbreak risk is spatially concentrated, we find that outbreaks are increasingly spreading throughout the broader population and across counties, but targeted interventions are predicted to prevent re-emergence nationwide. During the first decade of this period (2011-2020), outbreaks were only weakly associated with county-level vaccine coverage and predominantly isolated to single counties; however, recently (2021-2025), vaccine coverage has become strongly associated with outbreak size and spread across neighboring counties has increased. These findings suggest that measles transmission is increasingly sustained across the broader population rather than only in socially clustered communities. We developed a spatial statistical model to predict outbreak risk and size in all US counties with validation over 2021-2025; the model predicted counties with [≥]10 cases with a sensitivity of 95% (range across 2021-2025: 75-100%) and specificity of 83% (64-98%). Mechanistic models based on county vaccine coverage alone had worse performance, particularly in predicting larger outbreaks. Using the spatial statistical model, we find that prioritizing interventions in the areas of greatest model-predicted risk (e.g., top decile of US counties) was more impactful than state-level interventions (e.g., top five states) or targeting based on low vaccine coverage alone. Achieving even modest (5 percentage point) increases in vaccine coverage in counties in the top decile of model-predicted risk reduced long-term measles risk nationwide by over 90%. Together, these findings demonstrate that predictive risk modeling to inform spatially targeted interventions can likely mitigate the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases.

abstract_zh: 全球范围内,麻疹正在重新出现,包括之前已实现消除的美国。随着疫苗接种率的下降,描述麻疹重新出现的动力学和不断演变的空间模式对于指导公共卫生应对至关重要。我们分析了美国(US)2011年至2025年的年度县一级麻疹病例和疫苗接种覆盖率数据,并发现近年来麻疹的传播模式发生了变化,表明其重新出现。尽管暴发的风险在空间上集中,但我们发现暴发正在逐渐扩散到更广泛的人群和多个县,但有针对性的干预措施预计可以防止全国范围内的重新出现。在这一时期的第一十年(2011-2020年),暴发仅与县一级的疫苗接种覆盖率有较弱关联,并主要局限于单个县;然而,最近(2021-2025年),疫苗接种覆盖率与暴发的规模和向邻近县的扩散显著相关。这些发现表明,麻疹的传播正在逐渐从仅限于社会聚集社区扩展到更广泛的人群。我们开发了一个空间统计模型,用于预测美国所有县的暴发风险和规模,并在2021-2025年期间进行了验证;该模型预测了具有[≥]10例病例的县,其敏感度为95%(2021-2025年期间范围为75-100%),特异度为83%(64-98%)。仅基于县一级疫苗接种覆盖率的机制模型表现较差,尤其是在预测较大的暴发方面。利用该空间统计模型,我们发现,在模型预测风险最高的地区(例如美国县的前10%)优先实施干预措施,其效果比州级干预措施(例如前五大州)或仅基于低疫苗接种覆盖率的干预措施更为显著。在美国模型预测风险最高的县中,即使实现适度(5个百分点)的疫苗接种覆盖率提升,也能将全国范围内的长期麻疹风险降低超过90%。这些发现表明,通过预测性风险建模来指导空间针对性干预措施,可以有效遏制疫苗可预防疾病的重新出现。

title: Vaccination for girls and women across the life course: Evidence-based recommendations for clinical practice and policy.
abstract: Vaccination across the life course is a cornerstone of preventive health care for girls and women. Although WHO recommends completion of essential vaccines by adolescence, global coverage remains suboptimal. Vaccine-preventable diseases-including HPV-related cancers, vaginal, vulvar, anal, oropharyngeal, influenza, pertussis, hepatitis B, herpes zoster, and pneumococcal disease-continue to impose a disproportionate burden on girls and women, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) and migrant populations. Key life stages, such as childhood (early and middle), adolescence, preconception, pregnancy, postpartum, midlife, and beyond, offer critical opportunities for immunization. Obstetricians, gynecologists, midwives, and other women's healthcare providers are uniquely positioned to integrate vaccination into routine care in all settings and influence vaccine acceptance. Strengthening vaccine advocacy within women's health care is essential to reduce preventable morbidity and mortality and advance health equity for girls and women globally. This paper presents evidence-based recommendations for equitable vaccination across the life course of girls and women, synthesizing guidance from WHO, the Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization (SAGE), the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), and national immunization technical advisory groups. Vaccines reviewed include HPV, tetanus-diphtheria-pertussis (Tdap), influenza, hepatitis B, measles-mumps-rubella (MMR), varicella, herpes zoster, pneumococcal, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), and COVID-19. A life-course framework is proposed, emphasizing maternal immunization, cervical cancer prevention, and integration of regular and opportune vaccination into routine obstetric and gynecologic services. Practical implementation strategies and policy recommendations are outlined to support FIGO member societies.
journal: International journal of gynaecology and obstetrics: the official organ of the International Federation of Gynaecology and Obstetrics

title: Multiple Sclerosis and Viruses: « Liaisons Dangereuses ».
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a complex, multifactorial neurodegenerative disease with an aetiology that is still partially elusive. Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

Several risk factors are associated with MS development including genetic predisposition and various environmental stressors; however, recently, viral infections have gained significant attention as a crucial environmental trigger. Despite the well-established link between Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and MS susceptibility, a single-pathogen model fails to clearly characterise the molecular cascades driving the disease, suggesting that the transition from infection to autoimmune response involves more than one viral agent. In this review we examine the speculation that the interactions among different neurotropic viruses could serve a collective causative role in MS, which is under-researched in the literature at present. We summarise contradictory evidence on the role of different viral agents, including the Herpesviridae family (Human Cytomegalovirus, EBV, Herpes Simplex Viruses HSV-1 and HSV-2, and Varicella Zoster Virus), Paramyxoviridae family (Measles Virus and Rubella Virus), Influenza virus, SARS-CoV-2, and Human Endogenous Retroviruses (HERVs). Through interplay within shared molecular pathways, immune modulation, and activation of latent infections, these viruses may collectively influence the inflammatory and demyelinating processes that characterise MS. This review evaluates the etiological role of viral interplay in MS through the cumulative and interactive effects of these pathogens. The available epidemiological, immunological, and experimental data converge on the concept that viral co-exposures act synergistically to shape MS susceptibility in genetically predisposed individuals. Characterising these viral interactions presents a new research direction for the identification of novel biomarkers and the development of preventative strategies through the targeted control of viral networks.

title_zh: 多发性硬化症和病毒:《危险关系》。

abstract_zh: 多发性硬化症(MS)是一种复杂的、多因素的神经退行性疾病,其病因仍部分不明。与MS发病相关的风险因素包括遗传易感性和多种环境应激因素;然而,最近病毒感染引起了广泛关注,被认为是重要的环境诱因。尽管已知EB病毒(EBV)与MS易感性之间存在明确的关联,但单一病原体模型无法清晰描述驱动该疾病分子级联反应的机制,这表明从感染到自身免疫反应的转变可能涉及不止一种病毒。在本综述中,我们探讨了不同神经嗜性病毒之间的相互作用可能在MS中发挥协同致病作用的假设,这一领域目前在文献中研究较少。我们总结了不同病毒在MS发病中作用的矛盾证据,包括疱疹病毒科(人类巨细胞病毒、EB病毒、单纯疱疹病毒HSV-1和HSV-2,以及水痘-带状疱疹病毒)、副粘病毒科(麻疹病毒病毒和风疹病毒)、流感病毒、SARS-CoV-2以及人类内源性逆转录病毒(HERVs)。这些病毒可能通过在共享分子通路中的相互作用、免疫调节以及激活潜伏感染,共同影响MS中特征性的炎症和脱髓鞘过程。本综述评估了病毒相互作用在MS病因中的作用,通过这些病原体的累积和交互效应。现有的流行病学、免疫学和实验数据表明,病毒的共同暴露可能在遗传易感个体中协同影响MS的易感性。明确这些病毒相互作用为识别新型生物标志物和通过靶向控制病毒网络开发预防策略提供了新的研究方向。

title: Vaccine Response Assessment in Children Using Dried Blood Spots: The DRIVE Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dried blood spots (DBS) are a minimally invasive alternative to serum for serological surveillance, but pediatric data remain limited, particularly in high-resource settings and in immunocompromised children. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of DBS for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in a pediatric cohort from Madrid, Spain. METHODS: This prospective observational study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of DBS compared with serum samples in 134 children and adolescents (98 nonimmunocompromised, 36 immunocompromised) at La Paz University Hospital (Madrid, Spain). IgG antibodies against 6 vaccine-preventable diseases-diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, measles, mumps, and rubella-were quantified using the VirClia® IgG chemiluminescence assay. ROC curves were constructed to establish optimal DBS cutoff values for each pathogen. RESULTS: Using serum cutoffs, DBS showed sensitivities >95% and specificities >85% for all pathogens, except for pertussis, which had a sensitivity of 66.7%, and for rubella and mumps, which had specificities of 62.5% and 44.0%, respectively. Applying optimized DBS cutoffs improved specificity for rubella (81.2%) and mumps (88.0%). In immunocompromised children, sensitivity remained >80% for most pathogens but decreased for mumps (76.0%). Age and time since vaccination did not significantly affect DBS performance. CONCLUSIONS: Dried blood spot provide a reliable and practical approach for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in children and adolescents. Their ease of collection and transport make them especially valuable in settings with limited laboratory capacity. Population-specific cutoffs are essential, particularly for immunocompromised groups, to ensure diagnostic accuracy and support global immunization monitoring.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of dried blood spots (DBS) for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in children and adolescents, addressing the limited pediatric data in high-resource settings and immunocompromised children.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: A prospective observational study was conducted in 134 children and adolescents (98 nonimmunocompromised, 36 immunocompromised) at La Paz University Hospital in Madrid, Spain.
elements_en.methods: IgG antibodies against six vaccine-preventable diseases were quantified using the VirClia® IgG chemiluminescence assay, and ROC curves were constructed to establish optimal DBS cutoff values.
elements_en.main_results: DBS showed sensitivities >95% and specificities >85% for all pathogens except pertussis (66.7%), rubella (62.5%), and mumps (44.0%). Applying optimized DBS cutoffs improved specificity for rubella (81.2%) and mumps (88.0%).
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that DBS provide a reliable and practical approach for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in children and adolescents, particularly valuable in settings with limited laboratory capacity.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: DBS can support global immunization monitoring, especially in immunocompromised groups, and their ease of collection and transport make them valuable in resource-limited settings.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's population-specific cutoffs are essential, particularly for immunocompromised groups, to ensure diagnostic accuracy. Age and time since vaccination did not significantly affect DBS performance.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估干血斑(DBS)在评估儿童和青少年疫苗诱导的免疫力方面的诊断准确性,以解决高资源环境和免疫功能低下儿童中有限的儿科数据问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在西班牙马德里La Paz大学医院的134名儿童和青少年(98名非免疫功能低下,36名免疫功能低下)中进行了一项前瞻性观察性研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用VirClia® IgG化学发光检测法对六种疫苗可预防疾病的IgG抗体进行了定量分析,并构建ROC曲线以确定每种病原体的最佳DBS截断值。
elements_zh.main_results: DBS对所有病原体的敏感性均大于95%,特异性均大于85%,除了百日咳(敏感性为66.7%)、麻疹(特异性为44.0%)和腮腺炎(特异性为62.5%)。应用优化的DBS截断值提高了麻疹(81.2%)和腮腺炎(88.0%)的特异性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究证明,干血斑为评估儿童和青少年疫苗诱导的免疫力提供了一种可靠且实用的方法,尤其在实验室资源有限的环境中特别有价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 干血斑可以支持全球疫苗接种监测,特别是在免疫功能低下群体中,其采集和运输的简便性使其在资源有限的环境中具有重要价值。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究中针对特定人群的截断值是确保诊断准确性的关键,特别是在免疫功能低下群体中。年龄和接种疫苗接种后的时间对DBS性能没有显著影响。

title_zh: 使用干血斑评估儿童疫苗反应:DRIVE研究。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dried blood spots (DBS) are a minimally invasive alternative to serum for serological surveillance, but pediatric data remain limited, particularly in high-resource settings and in immunocompromised children. We evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of DBS for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in a pediatric cohort from Madrid, Spain. METHODS: This prospective observational study evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of DBS compared with serum samples in 134 children and adolescents (98 nonimmunocompromised, 36 immunocompromised) at La Paz University Hospital (Madrid, Spain). IgG antibodies against 6 vaccine-preventable diseases-diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, measles, mumps, and rubella-were quantified using the VirClia® IgG chemiluminescence assay. ROC curves were constructed to establish optimal DBS cutoff values for each pathogen. RESULTS: Using serum cutoffs, DBS showed sensitivities >95% and specificities >85% for all pathogens, except for pertussis, which had a sensitivity of 66.7%, and for rubella and mumps, which had specificities of 62.5% and 44.0%, respectively. Applying optimized DBS cutoffs improved specificity for rubella (81.2%) and mumps (88.0%). In immunocompromised children, sensitivity remained >80% for most pathogens but decreased for mumps (76.0%). Age and time since vaccination did not significantly affect DBS performance. CONCLUSIONS: Dried blood spot provide a reliable and practical approach for assessing vaccine-induced immunity in children and adolescents. Their ease of collection and transport make them especially valuable in settings with limited laboratory capacity. Population-specific cutoffs are essential, particularly for immunocompromised groups, to ensure diagnostic accuracy and support global immunization monitoring.
abstract_zh: 背景:干血斑(DBS)是血清的一种微创替代方法,用于血清学监测检测,但关于儿童的数据仍然有限,尤其是在高资源环境和免疫功能低下儿童中。我们评估了DBS在评估西班牙马德里La Paz大学医院中一名儿童队列研究所诱导的免疫力方面的诊断准确性。方法:这项前瞻性观察性研究在西班牙马德里La Paz大学医院的134名儿童和青少年(98名非免疫功能低下,36名免疫功能低下)中评估了DBS与血清样本相比的诊断准确性。使用VirClia® IgG化学发光检测法对6种疫苗可预防疾病的IgG抗体进行了定量分析,构建ROC曲线以确定每种病原体的最佳DBS截断值。结果:使用血清截断值,DBS对所有病原体的敏感性均大于95%,特异性均大于85%,除了百日咳(敏感性为66.7%)以及麻疹(特异性为44.0%)和腮腺炎(特异性为62.5%)。应用优化的DBS截断值提高了麻疹(81.2%)和腮腺炎(88.0%)的特异性。在免疫功能低下儿童中,大多数病原体的敏感性仍保持在80%以上,但麻疹的敏感性有所下降(76.0%)。年龄和接种疫苗接种后的时间对DBS性能没有显著影响。结论:干血斑为评估儿童和青少年疫苗诱导的免疫力提供了一种可靠且实用的方法。其采集和运输的简便性使其在实验室资源有限的环境中特别有价值。针对特定人群的截断值是确保诊断准确性和支持全球疫苗接种监测的关键。

title: Emerging Trends of Infectious Diseases in Canada
abstract: Emerging trends in infectious diseases in Canada reveal a dynamic landscape influenced by climate change, global travel, close interactions with livestock or wild animals, and increased antimicrobial resistance. Rising global temperatures and altered ecosystems have expanded the geographic range for key vector-borne diseases such as Lyme disease, tick-borne illnesses like anaplasmosis and babesiosis, and West Nile virus. Furthermore, urbanization and travel have complicated the overlapping interactions between humans, intermediate hosts (e.g., livestock and rodents), and insect/arthropod vectors. The resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases post-pandemic, including measles and pertussis, underscores the critical role of immunization programs to manage downstream impacts of vaccine hesitancy. The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted the need for robust public health infrastructure and preparedness to manage novel pathogens. Genomic surveillance and advanced diagnostics are enhancing the ability to detect and respond to outbreaks more swiftly. Additionally, the ongoing opioid crisis and disruptions to comprehensive healthcare have exacerbated the spread of bloodborne infections like HIV, hepatitis C, and tuberculosis among vulnerable populations. Moreover, Canada's multicultural population requires tailored public health strategies to address its diverse healthcare needs and disparities. Ongoing research, active surveillance, and interdisciplinary collaboration for clinical guidelines are essential to mitigate the impact of these emerging infectious diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨影响加拿大传染病爆发的因素,特别是关注疫情后麻疹及其他疫苗可预防传染病的再次出现。研究强调了理解气候变化、全球旅行和抗菌药物耐药性如何影响传染病动态景观的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了加拿大传染病的新兴趋势,包括麻疹和百日咳的再次流行,并考察了气候变化、全球旅行和抗菌药物耐受性等因素对这些趋势的影响。此外,还考虑了疫苗接种计划在应对疫苗犹豫现象带来的下游效应中的作用。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用对现有文献和加拿大传染病趋势数据的回顾,重点关注疫情后麻疹和百日咳的再次流行。它分析了气候变化、全球旅行和抗菌药物耐药性对这些趋势的影响,并评估了免疫接种计划在减轻其影响中的作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 加拿大传染病的新兴趋势显示出一个动态的图景,受到气候变化、全球旅行、与家畜或野生动物的密切接触以及抗菌药物耐受性增加的影响。在疫情后,麻疹可预防的疾病如疫苗和百日咳的再次出现,突显了疫苗接种计划在应对疫苗犹豫所带来的下游影响中的关键作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将麻疹和百日咳的再次流行解释为疫苗犹豫不决以及免疫接种计划削弱的直接结果,强调需要强大的公共卫生基础设施来有效应对这些挑战。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了维持和加强免疫接种计划以预防麻疹及其他疫苗可预防疾病的必要性,特别是在后疫情时代公共卫生准备的背景下。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于摘要证据,未提供详细的统计分析或具体的数值结果。然而,它提供了一个关于影响麻疹和百日咳病再度爆发的因素的一般概述,其结论具有中等程度的可信度。

title: Associations between parental generative artificial intelligence health-advice use and child vaccination uptake in Japan: an exploratory cross-sectional study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Parents increasingly use generative artificial intelligence (AI) for health information, but evidence on parental AI use and childhood vaccination is limited. We examined exploratory associations between regular parental AI health-advice use and childhood vaccination in Japan. METHODS: This cross-sectional study analyzed 2025 nationwide survey data from children aged 1 to 17 years and parents, with a linked 2023-2025 sub-analysis. The exposure was regular parental use of generative AI for health advice at least a few times per month. Outcomes were age-appropriate measles-rubella (MR) vaccination and any mumps, influenza, or coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccination. Modified Poisson regression estimated adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) and 95% confidence interval (95% CI) with parent-level clustering and covariates. RESULTS: Among 8282 children and 5170 parents, 1278 (15.4%) had regular AI health-advice users as parents. AI use was not associated with age-appropriate MR vaccination (aPR 1.02; 95% CI 0.97-1.09), but was associated with three vaccines. The adjusted rates were 76.6 versus 72.7% (aPR 1.05, 95% CI 1.01-1.10) for mumps, 56.7% versus 49.0% (aPR 1.16, 95% CI 1.08-1.24) for influenza, 40.6% versus 30.9% (aPR 1.31, 95% CI 1.19-1.45) for COVID-19. The COVID-19 association was strongest among parents younger than 30 years (aPR 2.58; 95% CI 1.90-3.50; P for interaction < 0.001). In the linked sub-analysis, these associations persisted after adjustment for an available 2023 household-level prior vaccination marker and attitudes. CONCLUSIONS: Regular parental use of generative AI for health advice was associated with mumps, influenza, and COVID-19 vaccination, but not with age-appropriate MR vaccination. These exploratory, cross-sectional findings are observational associations. They may reflect digital health engagement, health information seeking, socioeconomic differences, or favorable attitudes, rather than vaccine-specific AI advice.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the association between parental use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) for health advice and child vaccination uptake in Japan. The cross-sectional analysis of 2025 nationwide survey data found that regular AI use was not linked to age-appropriate measles-rubella (MR) vaccination but was associated with increased uptake of mumps, influenza, and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) vaccines. The strongest association was observed among parents younger than 30 years for COVID-19 vaccination. The study highlights potential links between digital health engagement and vaccination behavior, though it acknowledges the observational nature of the findings and possible confounding factors such as socioeconomic status and attitudes. These results may inform public health strategies aimed at leveraging digital tools to enhance vaccination rates, but further research is needed to establish causality and explore mechanisms.

title: Seroprevalence of 17 pathogens from an integrated national serosurvey in Niue
abstract: Integrated serosurveillance (ISS), using multiplex bead assays to measure antibodies to multiple pathogens, can provide insights into population immunity and pathogen exposure. We estimated seroprevalence for neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), arboviruses, vaccine-preventable diseases, and enteric protozoa in Niue through a cross-sectional survey embedded within a World Health Organization (WHO) STEPwise survey from 24 February to 4 April 2025. Dried blood spots from participants aged ≥ 3 years were tested for 26 pathogen-specific antibodies. Among 750 participants (median age 37 years; range 3–93; 53% female), NTD seroprevalence was low (0% for yaws [among 165 participants aged ≤ 14 years] to 2.7% for cysticercosis). Arbovirus seroprevalence ranged from 3.1% (Zika) to 35.1% (dengue serotype 4). Dengue seropositivity increased with age ( p < 0.05). Measles and rubella seroprevalence exceeded 98%, while diphtheria and tetanus seropositivity was lower in older age groups ( p ≤ 0.03). Cryptosporidium seroprevalence (68.7%) increased with age ( p < 0.001), while Giardia seroprevalence was low (4.1%). Findings demonstrate the utility of ISS to generate policy-relevant surveillance data, although interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and non-probability sampling.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess population immunity and pathogen exposure in Niue through integrated serosurveillance, highlighting the importance of understanding seroprevalence for public health planning.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional survey embedded within a WHO STEPwise survey was conducted from 24 February to 4 April 2025, involving 750 participants aged ≥ 3 years with a median age of 37 years and 53% female.
analysis.methods: Dried blood spots from participants were tested for 26 pathogen-specific antibodies using multiplex bead assays as part of an integrated serosurveillance approach.
analysis.main_results: Measles and rubella seroprevalence exceeded 98%, while diphtheria and tetanus seropositivity was lower in older age groups (p ≤ 0.03).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate the utility of integrated serosurveillance for generating policy-relevant data, although interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and non-probability sampling.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide critical insights into immunity levels against measles and other vaccine-preventable diseases, informing targeted public health interventions and vaccination strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design and non-probability sampling, which may affect the generalisability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted an integrated serosurveillance (ISS) in Niue to assess population immunity and pathogen exposure. It involved a cross-sectional survey of 750 participants aged ≥ 3 years, using dried blood spots and multiplex bead assays to test for 26 pathogen-specific antibodies. The results showed high measles and rubella seroprevalence (>98%) and lower diphtheria and tetanus seropositivity in older age groups (p ≤ 0.03). The study highlights the value of ISS for generating policy-relevant data but notes limitations due to its cross-sectional design and non-probability sampling. These findings have implications for public health planning, particularly in informing vaccination strategies and assessing immunity levels in the population. The evidence strength is moderate due to the study's design and sampling limitations.

We estimated seroprevalence for neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), arboviruses, vaccine-preventable diseases, and enteric protozoa in Niue through a cross-sectional survey embedded within a World Health Organization (WHO) STEPwise survey from 24 February to 4 April 2025. Dried blood spots from participants aged ≥ 3 years were tested for 26 pathogen-specific antibodies. Among 750 participants (median age 37 years; range 3–93; 53% female), NTD seroprevalence was low (0% for yaws [among 165 participants aged ≤ 14 years] to 2.7% for cysticercosis). Arbovirus seroprevalence ranged from 3.1% (Zika) to 35.1% (dengue serotype 4). Dengue seropositivity increased with age ( p < 0.05). Measles and rubella seroprevalence exceeded 98%, while diphtheria and tetanus seropositivity was lower in older age groups ( p ≤ 0.03). Cryptosporidium seroprevalence (68.7%) increased with age ( p < 0.001), while Giardia seroprevalence was low (4.1%). Findings demonstrate the utility of ISS to generate policy-relevant surveillance data, although interpretation is limited by the cross-sectional design and non-probability sampling.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过综合血清流行病学监测评估纽埃的人群免疫和病原体暴露情况,强调理解血清流行率对于公共卫生规划的重要性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 于2025年2月24日至4月4日,通过世界卫生组织(WHO)步骤式调查中的横断面调查,对750名≥3岁、中位年龄为37岁、女性占53%的参与者进行了调查。
analysis_zh.methods: 参与者干燥血液斑点通过多路珠阵列测定26种病原体特异性抗体,作为综合血清流行病学监测的一部分。
analysis_zh.main_results: 抗白喉和麻疹血清流行率超过98%,而抗白喉和破伤风血清阳性率在较年长的年龄组较低(p ≤ 0.03)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明综合血清流行病学监测对于生成与政策相关的数据具有实用价值,尽管解释受到横断面设计和非概率抽样的限制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对抗白喉和其他可预防疾病的免疫水平的关键见解,为有针对性的公共卫生干预和策略提供了信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 研究受到横断面设计和非概率抽样的限制,可能影响研究结果的普遍性。证据强度为中等。

title: Evaluation of Vaccination Coverage and Compliance Among Medical Students: A Cross-Sectional Documentary Analysis
abstract: Introduction: Vaccination is a cornerstone of primary healthcare, particularly critical for medical students and healthcare professionals due to constant occupational exposure to infectious agents.This study aimed to evaluate the vaccination status of medical students at a private higher education institution in the Federal District, Brazil, comparing their self-perceived protection with actual immunization records.Methods: A cross-sectional, descriptive study was conducted between August 2024 and July 2025, involving 90 medical students from various semesters.Data collection utilized structured online questionnaires and documentary analysis of digital vaccination cards submitted via the "Meu SUS Digital" platform or physical records.Evaluated immunizations included hepatitis A, hepatitis B (HBV), measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR), tetanus/dT, yellow fever, meningococcal C and ACWY, influenza (2024 campaign), and COVID-19.Data were analyzed using absolute and relative frequencies.Results: Although 75 (83.3%)participants self-reported having an up-to-date vaccination card and 85 (94.4%) felt protected for clinical practice, documentary analysis revealed severe gaps.Only 16 (19.3%)participants possessed a completely up-to-date occupational schedule for all analyzed immunogens.Significant deficits included 56 (67.5%) lacking hepatitis A doses, 77 (92.8%) lacking meningococcal ACWY records, and 22 (26.5%)lacking the 2024 influenza vaccine.The primary reasons cited for missing vaccines were lack of availability at the appropriate age (n = 10, 43.5%) and unknown causes (n = 10, 43.5%).Descriptively, students with parents in the healthcare field and those in advanced internship semesters showed proportionally higher completeness rates, although overall coverage remained insufficient.Furthermore, 57 (63.3%) respondents recognized a lack of information regarding occupational infection risks during their academic training.Conclusions: A profound discrepancy exists between medical students' perceived immunological protection and their actual immunization status.These findings highlight an urgent need for institutional interventions, curriculum enhancements, and mandatory vaccination verification protocols to safeguard students and patients in clinical learning environments.

title: Determinants of Delayed and Missed Childhood Immunization Among Mothers Attending Primary Healthcare Centers in Al-Diwaniyah City, Iraq: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Background: Childhood immunization is a cost-effective public health intervention; however, delayed and missed vaccinations remain significant challenges. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and key determinants of childhood immunization non-compliance among mothers attending primary healthcare centers (PHCs). Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 300 mothers of children aged 0–24 months attending PHCs. Data were collected using structured, interviewer-administered questionnaires and verified through immunization cards. Non-compliance was defined as a delay of ≥4 weeks beyond the scheduled date or omission of a due vaccine dose. Binary logistic regression was performed using SPSS version 26 to identify independent predictors. Results: Immunization non-compliance was observed in 49.7% of children (n=149). The highest non-compliance rates were reported for IPV (35.7%), measles-rubella vaccine (34.3%), and the third dose of pentavalent vaccine (25.3%). Major barriers included child illness on vaccination day (45.0%), caregiver forgetfulness (38.9%), and fear of adverse effects (32.9%). ; ; M; Primary healthcare; Vaccine hesitancy; Immunization barriers; Cross-sectional study.
journal: UPI Journal of Pharmaceutical Medical and Health Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study examines the prevalence and determinants of childhood immunization non-compliance among mothers in Al-Diwaniyah City, Iraq. The study identifies key barriers such as child illness, caregiver forgetfulness, and fear of adverse effects. The results suggest the need for targeted interventions to improve immunization compliance, particularly for measles-related vaccines.

This study aimed to determine the prevalence and key determinants of childhood immunization non-compliance among mothers attending primary healthcare centers (PHCs). Methods: A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted among 300 mothers of children aged 0–24 months attending PHCs. Data were collected using structured, interviewer-administered questionnaires and verified through immunization cards. Non-compliance was defined as a delay of ≥4 weeks beyond the scheduled date or omission of a due vaccine dose. Binary logistic regression was performed using SPSS version 26 to identify independent predictors. Results: Immunization non-compliance was observed in 49.7% of children (n=149). The highest non-compliance rates were reported for IPV (35.7%), measles-rubella vaccine (34.3%), and the third dose of pentavalent vaccine (25.3%). Major barriers included child illness on vaccination day (45.0%), caregiver forgetfulness (38.9%), and fear of adverse effects (32.9%). ; ; M; Primary healthcare; Vaccine hesitancy; Immunization barriers; Cross-sectional study.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在300名0至24个月儿童的母亲中开展了一项描述性横断面研究,她们在初级卫生保健中心接受服务。
analysis_zh.methods: 数据通过结构化的、由访谈员实施的问卷收集,并通过免疫接种卡进行验证。非依从性被定义为延迟≥4周超过计划日期或遗漏应接种的疫苗剂量。使用SPSS版本26进行二元逻辑回归分析以确定独立预测因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 有49.7%的儿童出现疫苗接种不依从性(n=149)。报告的最高不依从率出现在IPV(35.7%)、麻疹-麻疹病毒(34.3%)以及五联疫苗第三剂(25.3%)中。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究突出了疫苗接种不依从性的患病率,并确定了特定类型的疫苗,其延迟和遗漏率较高。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善疫苗接种依从性提供有针对性的策略,特别是针对麻疹-麻疹和五联疫苗疫苗。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于一个城市,并依赖于自我报告的数据,这可能会引入回忆偏倚。由于这些局限性,证据强度中等。

title: Detection and Phylogenetic Characterization of Canine Distemper Virus (Morbillivirus canis) in Wild Foxes and Badgers from Northern Italy in 2021–2026
abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a highly contagious multisystemic pathogen posing severe threats to wild carnivores and domestic animals. To investigate CDV circulation and lineage diversity in Piacenza Province, Northern Italy, wildlife surveillance was conducted under the Regional Wildlife Monitoring Plan between 2021 and June 2026. Forty-three wild carnivores—comprising red foxes (Vulpes vulpes), European badgers (Meles meles), wolves (Canis lupus), stone martens (Martes foina), and one jackal (Canis aureus)—were evaluated by necropsy, histopathology and molecular assays (RT-qPCR/RT-PCR). Overall, 12 animals (27.9%, 95% CI: 15.3–43.7; six foxes and six badgers) were confirmed to be CDV-positive. No positivity was found before 2024. Positive animals displayed characteristic lesions, including hemorrhagic enteritis, pulmonary hepatization, and footpad hyperkeratosis. Sequencing of the hemagglutinin (H) gene of the four complete H genes obtained revealed that they belonged to clade A of the European/South American 1 lineage, showing the highest nucleotide identity with Alpine CDV strains from Switzerland and Northern Italy. These results confirm the recent circulation of CDV amongst foxes and badgers in Piacenza. Continuous molecular monitoring and integrated cross-border surveillance remain essential for the effective management of transmission at the interface between wildlife and domestic animals.
